decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side dormer and the landing window on the first floor side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - The erection of side and rear roof extensions, a first floor rear extension and single storey rear and side extensions to the existing house, as shown on drawing numbers 449 P030 Revision B & 449 P031 Revision B received 23 November 2006 (Amended plans), is satisfactory as the size, position and appearance are acceptable and would satisfactorily maintain the amenity of adjoining neighbours and are considered to preserve and enhance the character and appearance of the Chiswick House Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations; and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of side and rear roof extensions and erection of side and rear single storey rear extensions to the existing house
